description: Runtime performance budgets for the Issue #883 apps/dsa-web surfaces plus the T16 shared DataTable contract. Structural scenarios may be blocking. Timing, network, and Desktop measurements stay skip or observe and must not become CI hard gates from a single machine's wall-clock.
referenceHardware: Apple Silicon / modern x86 laptop, production build, Chrome. Wall-clock numbers are manual guidance only.
baselineNote: Do not shrink declared input sizes, remove product features, encode one machine's absolute speed, or hide regressions with broad margins. Network and Desktop timing are never blocking.

aggregation.note: Checker discards warmup runs and compares the median of measured runs. Structural counts are deterministic; repeats exist to catch runner jitter before a scenario is blocking, not to widen budgets.

flakePolicy.structuralBlocking: Zero flakes. Median of measuredRuns after warmupRuns must stay within the budget on CI. Do not raise the budget to swallow variance; fix the fixture or the product.
flakePolicy.observe: Exceedances print WARN and do not fail web-gate. Promote to blocking only after repeated CI medians are stable at the declared input size.
flakePolicy.skipUnavailable: Skip is a first-class result, not a pass. A skip without skipReason fails closed. Missing measurements for blocking or observe scenarios fail closed so coverage cannot be dropped to go green.
flakePolicy.timingAndNetwork: kind=timing and kind=network cannot use gate=blocking. Do not commit wall-clock budgets taken from a developer laptop.
flakePolicy.retries: CI does not retry this step. Re-run locally with the same --warmup/--repeat flags. If a structural test is order-dependent, fix the test.

baselineUpdate.structural: Keep the declared input size. Change budget only with checker --print evidence from this suite, a product reason, and a changelog fragment. Prefer fixing the regression over raising the number.
baselineUpdate.observeToBlocking: Require three local measured medians plus one hosted web-gate log at the same input size, all within the budget, with sample range that does not need a wider cap.
baselineUpdate.skip: Do not convert skip to blocking without a CI-reproducible structural metric. Leave Desktop and network skip.

rollback: Revert the PR (or restore modeDefault soft + the previous three-scenario JSON). Bundle-size aggregate families stay independent.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883 / T16: tables > 100 rows virtualize or hard-paginate. Shared DataTable now reuses useVirtualWindow once row count >= 24 and the table has no variable-height detail rows. Budget = ceil(viewport/estimatedRow) + 2*overscan with headroom (viewport 480px, default row 48px, overscan 6 => ~10+12=22, cap 40).
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: render DataTable with 150 rows; count mounted body-row test IDs inside the shared scroll region.
scenarios.manualTarget: Scroll remains interactive; first and last rows remain reachable; find-in-page still works for tables below the threshold.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883: tables/lists > 100 rows virtualize or hard-paginate. History already pages (20/page) but accumulates; with 150 loaded items, mounted HistoryListItem nodes must stay within viewport + overscan rather than O(n). Budget = ceil(viewport/estimatedRow) + 2*overscan with headroom (viewport 480px, row ~72px, overscan 6 => ~19+12=31, cap 40).
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: render HistoryList with 150 items in a fixed-height scroll viewport; count [data-history-list-item] nodes.
scenarios.manualTarget: Scroll remains interactive; no multi-second main-thread freezes when the rail holds 100+ history rows.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883: signals tables virtualize or hard-paginate. The feed page model slices merged results to PAGE_SIZE 20; the section must not mount the undeclared remainder of a 150-item universe.
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: build 150 signals, slice with mergeWatchlistSignalResponses, render the feed; count article cards.
scenarios.manualTarget: Signal Center feed stays paginated; changing page does not mount the full result set.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883: screening tables > 100 rows virtualize or hard-paginate. This table currently mounts every candidate and uses variable-height row details, so T16 windowing does not apply. Observe at the real 150-row input; do not raise the budget to hide the unbounded render. Promote only after pagination or a compatible window lands.
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: render ScreeningResultsSection with 150 candidates; count body rows.
scenarios.manualTarget: Screening results stay interactive at 100+ candidates; prefer pagination or virtualization over mounting the full set.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883: Settings field edit must not full-page remount or re-render every sibling field on each keystroke. With memo boundaries, changing one field value yields 0 sibling SettingsField commits.
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: mount 40 fields; change one value; assert sibling React.Profiler commits stay at 0.
scenarios.manualTarget: Typing in a large category panel does not visibly lock the shell or nav.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883: chat stream must keep Stop responsive and avoid multi-second UI freezes. Pre-fix path committed progressSteps once per SSE event (O(n) React commits per burst). rAF batching bounds commits to ~1/frame; budget of 4 allows startStream setup + flush frames + terminal cleanup without requiring exact frame timing.
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: feed 60 progress events in one readable stream chunk; count progressSteps-affecting setState commits until the stream settles; stopStream remains callable mid-stream.
scenarios.manualTarget: Stop button responds within ~100ms perceived latency under long tool/progress streams; UI is not frozen multi-second.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883: markdown re-parse during SSE must not rebuild prior bubbles. Memoized ChatMessageBubble nodes keep DOM identity while live progress updates.
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: render 8 completed messages plus live progress; update progressSteps; count prior data-chat-message-id nodes that were replaced.
scenarios.manualTarget: Completed bubbles stay still while the live trace updates; Stop remains tappable.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883: multi-column Home concurrent widgets must remain independent slots, not one unbounded tree. Default layout ships four widgets; dropping below that is a coverage regression.
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: render HomeDashboardLayout with the four production widget ids; count [data-testid^=home-dashboard-widget-] nodes.
scenarios.manualTarget: Home widgets can load independently; one slow widget does not replace the board.

scenarios.skipReason: Per-route bundle split is enforced by apps/dsa-web/scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs aggregateRules (T20). The runtime checker must not re-measure gzip or treat bundle bytes as a runtime timing budget.
scenarios.rationale: Issue #883 called out unclear per-route bundle split. That gate already blocks in web-gate after the production build.
scenarios.measurement: none (skip). Use node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs --print after npm run build.
scenarios.manualTarget: Named route families stay under their aggregate gzip caps; do not split chunks to hide growth.

scenarios.skipReason: Desktop idle CPU/GPU is not measurable in Web jsdom CI. Manual profiling on a long-lived desktop session only; never a blocking runtime-perf number.
scenarios.rationale: Issue #883 Desktop power-profile question stays open. Encoding this runner's idle percent would be machine-specific and flaky.
scenarios.manualTarget: Desktop left open with schedules + chat should not peg CPU/GPU; collect traces outside CI.

scenarios.rationale: Issue #883: shell + nav before heavy widgets. Sidebar, main, and mobile header must mount even when the route outlet is a pending stub. Route-switch ~300ms remains manual wall-clock guidance and is not a CI budget.
scenarios.measurement: vitest contract: render Shell with a pending child; count [data-shell-sidebar], [data-shell-main], and [data-shell-mobile-header].
scenarios.manualTarget: Primary route switch interactive under ~300ms on a reference laptop (prod build). Do not promote that wall-clock to blocking from one machine.

wallClockGuidance.note: Wall-clock numbers are reference-laptop guidance for manual profiling (React Profiler + Performance panel). CI never enforces them. Do not copy this machine's milliseconds into blocking budgets.
